# DeepSpikingEnsembleLayers

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A deep network architecture composed of stacked layers of functional ensembles, where each layer transforms sparse spike patterns into higher-level ensemble representations. This bridges deep learning and neuromorphic computing, providing a scalable framework for TCC to map hierarchical computations onto distributed in-network processing elements.
